verdict.rationale: a-Shell supports Apple Shortcuts integration for scripted automation and executes a .profile script on the event of opening a new window, giving limited event-triggered behavior, but there is no built-in rules engine, webhook, or generalized event-trigger system within the app itself. missing for 10: native event-listener/trigger system, documented examples of automation rules beyond Shortcuts and .profile, independent verification of Shortcuts-based automation working reliably.
